name: EVR Nagammai Scholarship
eligibility: Girl students pursuing postgraduate degree courses in Arts and Science from a recognised college in Tamil Nadu.
apply: Apply through the Directorate of Collegiate Education

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for BC MBC DNC Students
eligibility: BC, MBC and DNC students pursuing eligible college, professional, diploma, postgraduate or PhD courses, subject to scheme conditions.
benefit: Tuition fee, special fee, examination fee and other eligible educational assistance as applicable
apply: Apply through the institution / Unified State Scholarship Portal as applicable

name: Scholarship for Differently Abled Students
eligibility: Differently abled students from school level through higher and professional education, subject to the applicable conditions.
benefit: Financial assistance based on level of study
apply: Apply through the concerned District Differently Abled Welfare Officer
